editorial.changeReason: Create privacy-safe source templates for Revisit reminders and support receipts.

email.revisit.actionLabel.description: Action label for opening the private Revisit route.

email.revisit.body.description: Privacy-safe Revisit reminder body with locale-aware date and explicit time-zone context.

email.revisit.preferenceLabel.description: Label for opening reminder settings without mutating preference through a GET request.

email.revisit.preview.message: Your private Revisit is ready when you are.

email.revisit.subject.description: Lock-screen-safe Revisit reminder subject using configured brand text.

email.shared.supportLabel.description: Label for the configured support email link.

email.support.accountLabel.description: Action label for opening the private account route after a support request.

email.support.body.description: Support receipt body that limits sensitive information shared by email.
email.support.body.message: We received your support request on {receivedDate} at {receivedTime} ({timeZone}). Share only the details needed to help with this request; do not send journal, prayer, birth-time, or private reading text by email.

email.support.replyLabel.description: Label for replying through the configured support address.
